item.title: Iran targets commerce as drone hits Dubai airport; Israel says war will go on
item.summary: As Tehran continued strikes on targets across the Gulf region, Israel said it would hit Iran for “as long as needed” and expanded ground operations in Lebanon.

item.title: To criticize an American-led war, an American pope turns to allies
item.summary: A split-screen response shows how Pope Leo is navigating a minefield as the Trump administration projects American nativism at home and deadly force overseas.

item.title: Trump says U.S. struck Kharg Island, core of Iran’s oil economy
item.summary: The strikes destroyed more than 90 military targets, including missile facilities, but preserved oil infrastructure, U.S. Central Command said Saturday.

item.title: Trump-Xi summit likely delayed as president pushes China to help open Hormuz
item.summary: Trump said the long-anticipated reboot of U.S.-China relations could be postponed amid mounting pressure to reopen the critical oil route in the Persian Gulf.

item.title: Deportees sent by Trump to Salvadoran prison are still stuck a year later
item.summary: Little is known about the status or whereabouts of the Salvadorans deported by President Donald Trump to CECOT, an infamous megaprison.
